"it gets ever closer to 0 V but never reaches it" and "It never reaches 0 V" say this of the capacitor itself, while the explain and the ignores note rightly say it of the rule; write "the rule never reaches 0 V" so a real capacitor is not claimed never to discharge.

Why? opens before Check and states 1,024, which undoes the guess-first point of this screen; show Why? only once an answer has been checked here.
